notes: Three new games — Texas Hold'em, Blackjack and Backgammon — solo and in group chats (poker up to 6 players, blackjack up to 5, backgammon 1v1). Backgammon shows every reachable move including combined dice, double-tap to play. Real felt, marble and wood board textures. Checkers multi-capture chains, chess last-move highlight, redesigned penalty shootout. The live game now floats over the chat instead of pushing it down. Plus a security hardening pass under the hood.
